name: Byouin Adventure: Kariguwae no Arie-sensei
original_name: 病院アドベンチャー カリ咥えの有恵先生
source:
There's a rumour spreading among the patients of Himegaoka Hospital. 
Three hard-edged patients take on the challenge of discovering it!
